executive_summary: The agent's patch is functionally identical to the gold patch. It correctly prevents saving Klarna and Affirm pay-later payment methods during on-session payments by introducing a configurable unsupported-payment-methods map, checking setup_future_usage, and skipping persistence when the combination is unsupported. All changes compile successfully and are backward-compatible.

approach_analysis.explanation: The agent implemented exactly the same approach as the gold patch: (1) added config sections across all deployment configs, (2) added an is_on_session() helper to FutureUsage, (3) added an OnSessionConfig settings struct, (4) added a domain model helper to check unsupported combinations, and (5) gated the save flow in payment_response.rs using that helper. There are no material deviations.

praised_patterns.observation: The guard correctly short-circuits the save_payment_method call by mutating should_avoid_saving before the legacy-mandate and normal-save branches.
The helper cleanly checks both payment_method and payment_method_type presence before probing the unsupported map, avoiding panics and handling partial data gracefully.
OnSessionConfig derives Default, and the parent Settings struct carries #[serde(default)], so missing config keys will safely default to an empty unsupported map.
praised_patterns.evidence: #[derive(Debug, Deserialize, Clone, Default)] pub struct OnSessionConfig { pub unsupported_payment_methods: HashMap<enums::PaymentMethod, HashSet<enums::PaymentMethodType>> }

praise_worthy_patterns.pattern: New config fields propagate through secrets_transformers.rs identically to existing fields.
Config is consistently added to all five deployment config files.

compilation_assessment.notes: cargo_check_affected passed (rc=0, elapsed=219.6s) for all relevant crates including router, common_enums, and hyperswitch_domain_models.
